addon.changelog:
NEW
- Boolean strokes: Difference, Union, Intersection and Intersection Additive operations on your Fill shapes. Enable an operation to have it apply automatically, or trigger it manually with a shortcut
- Stroke to Fill: automatically transforms your strokes into a Fill shape, and works well together with the boolean operations

IMPROVEMENTS
- Brush import rebuilt entirely: brushes come in much closer to how they look in the app you exported them from, and it's future-proofed for Blender's next brush engine features
- Blender 5.1 and 5.2 support: bugfixes, compatibility improvements, and much deeper integration with Grease Pencil's new features - point placement Radius / Density, Texture Rotation, and no need to set Line and Fill layers as the stroke type now comes from the material and the drawing mode directly

And many other improvements and fixes.
